name.zh: 平行杆团身 L 撑

purpose.zh: 练腹部和抬腿的力量，提升撑住身体的能力
purpose.en: Build your abs and leg-lifting strength while you hold yourself up.

text.zh: 手臂撑直，膝盖抬到胸前
text.en: Lock your arms and pull your knees to your chest
Press your shoulders down, away from your ears.

text.zh: 做得稳了，再试着两腿轮流往前伸直。
text.en: Once it feels steady, try straightening one leg forward, then the other.

commonErrors.en: Shrugging and letting the neck shorten.

cautions.en: Stop if your wrists hurt or go numb.
Warm up your wrists before you start.

changes: 动画是一直撑着团身，中间一条腿伸直再收回（进阶演示），保持计时不变，training=hold
主口令删掉「肩下压」，一句只说一件事；「骨盆后倾」删掉；结束口令改为「慢慢放下」（原「收回团身」和起始重复）
purpose 去掉「髋屈肌」；cautions 改成「X 时 Y」短句
真实做法进阶时两腿轮流伸，cue 改「两腿轮流」
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
